content:
\>be me  
\>closeted cute girly boy  
\>just tryna exist in peace  
\>see boy  
\>brain immediately goes: “i just want to hold his hand”  
\>not even *his* specifically  
\>literally any boy  
\>just once want that dumb cheesy hallway handholding like it’s not a federal crime  

\>imagine it  
\>walking down the hall  
\>hands linked  
\>normal human affection.jpg  
\>except instead of “aww” it’s  
\>lined up against the walls of public rejection  
\>speedrunning social exile any%  
\>ostracized for being who i am  

\>why does anyone care so much  
\>why do they hate us for loving  
\>the irony is physically painful  
\>hear people casually insulting us like we’re some mythological creature  
\>like we don’t exist  
\>like i’m not literally standing right there  

\>realize if i ever step out of this cage  
\>any chance of a social life i had gets obliterated  
\>reduced to atoms  
\>but god forbid i want to be a cute girly boy  
\>what’s wrong with it  
\>mfw holding a boy’s hand is apparently the end of civilization
